name: Loop_CombinePolygons
formula: =LAMBDA(verticesText,verticesArrText,[count],LET(i, IF(ISOMITTED(count), 1, count), n, ROWS(verticesArrText), verticesA, VALUE({ref}TextToArray(verticesText)), verticesB, VALUE({ref}TextToArray(INDEX(verticesArrText, i, 1))), combinedPolys, {ref}CombineTwoPolygons(verticesA, verticesB), isCombined, ROWS(combinedPolys) = 1, returnVerticesArrText, IF(isCombined, IF(n = 1, combinedPolys, VSTACK(combinedPolys, {ref}RemoveRow(verticesArrText, i))), VSTACK(verticesArrText, verticesText)), out, IF(OR(i = n, isCombined), returnVerticesArrText, Loop_CombinePolygons(verticesText, verticesArrText, i + 1)), out))
